note: All speeds were lowered ≈ 10 % (≈ 12 % longer speech: Kokoro is not linear in speed) (and the elder's pitch shift removed) after the owner asked for slower, lighter voices. Who speaks with which voice. tools/voice.py reads this; each line's `speaker` (default: narrator) picks an entry. Kokoro-82M v1.0 voice ids; speed is Kokoro's speed; pitch is in semitones (resampled after synthesis, speed kept). Mirrors CHARACTERS.md.

narrator.notes: Episode 1's voice: warm, even, American. Was 0.9×, until the owner asked for slower, lighter narration (about 12 % longer speech).

sauti.notes: The storyteller: a lighter British voice with a bard's lilt, distinct from the narrator. Was 0.92× (about 12 % longer speech).

elder_sage.notes: Shaunaka: older and slower; the deepest British voice (median F0 ≈ 95 Hz vs the narrator's ≈ 129), unshifted (the −0.5 st shift was removed to keep him light), at 0.77× (was 0.8×; with the new comma pause his lines run ≈ 25 % longer).

vyasa.notes: Reserved for future episodes: a grave, measured voice (bm_george lowered 2.5 st).

janamejaya.notes: Younger and brighter than the narrator (am_michael +1 st). Speaks from episode 8 (his vow); 0.86× (was 0.9× while reserved) to match the slower cast.

pitrs.notes: Episode 33: the Yayavaras, Jaratkaru's ancestors, as one voice (bm_daniel −2 st, slow).

sarama.notes: Episode 5: Sarama, the divine dog (devashuni). The best-graded Kokoro voice, slowed and lowered 1.5 st: calm, grave, never shrill; a mother's dignity, not a growl.

queen.notes: Episode 6: King Paushya's queen. A clear, composed British voice: royal and kind, her warning quiet.

guru_patni.notes: Episode 6: the teacher's wife. Reserved (her request is narrated).

uttanka.notes: Episode 6: Uttanka, the young student. Bright and young, set apart from the narrator and from Janamejaya (am_michael).

takshaka.notes: Episode 6+: Takshaka, the serpent king. Reserved: cold, slow, lowered 3 st.

kuru_princes.notes: Episode 5: Janamejaya's brothers (Shrutasena, Ugrasena, Bhimasena). Reserved: they do not speak.

sarama_pup.notes: Episode 5: Sarama's son. Reserved: he only whimpers (sound design in the score).

ganesha.notes: Episode 4: Ganesha, the scribe. A warm, unhurried American voice (median F0 ≈ 114 Hz: between the narrator and the elder), distinct from every other cast voice.

vaishampayana.notes: Episode 47+: Vaishampayana, Vyasa's student, the first teller. Changed before first use (the bible had bm_fable +1.5, Sauti's own voice: two nested narrators must not sound alike): bm_daniel raised 1 st, British like his teacher (bm_george).

parikshit.notes: Episode 7: King Parikshit, Janamejaya's father. A mature, tired, commanding American voice, lowered 1 st: older than his son (am_michael +1 st), apart from the narrator.

shamika.notes: Episode 7: the sage Shamika. Reserved: under a vow of silence, he does not speak on screen (his warning is narrated). Unshifted bm_george (Vyasa uses it −2.5 st).

shringin.notes: Episode 7: Shringin, Shamika's young son, who curses the king. Young and hot, quicker than anyone else in the cast; apart from Uttanka (am_puck).

indra.notes: Episode 8+: Indra, king of the gods. Broad and regal, lowered 1.5 st; no one else uses am_adam.

priests.notes: Episode 8: the sacrificial priests (ritvij). Reserved: their chant is in the score.

sthapati.notes: Episode 8: the builder (sthapati) who measures the ground. Reserved: his warning is narrated.

kashyapa.notes: Episode 9+: the sage Kashyapa (the Prajapati), husband of Kadru and Vinata. Calm and paternal, lowered 1 st (the Pitrs use bm_daniel −2 st, reserved).

kadru.notes: Episode 9+: Kadru, mother of the serpents. Cool, proud and clear; a little lower than her sister.

vinata.notes: Episode 9+: Vinata, mother of Aruna and Garuda. Soft and earnest; set apart from Kadru (bf_alice) and the queen (bf_emma).

aruna.notes: Episode 10: Aruna, Vinata's half-formed first son, the red of dawn. Young but grave: am_echo raised 2.5 st (Ganesha uses it unshifted).

surya.notes: Episode 10+: Surya, the Sun. Reserved (he does not speak in episode 10); warm and grave.

vishnu.notes: Episode 11+: Narayana (Vishnu). Calm, deep, unhurried; am_fenrir lowered 1 st (Takshaka, reserved, uses it at -3 st and 0.74x: far apart).

brahma.notes: Episode 11+: Brahma, the Grandfather. The deepest British voice lowered 2 st and slower than the elder sage (unshifted, 0.77x).

devas.notes: Episode 11+: the gods as a group (reserved).

asuras.notes: Episode 11+: the asuras as a group (reserved): heavy, low.

samudra.notes: Episode 12: the Ocean (Samudra). A broad, deep voice (am_santa lowered 2 st), used by no one else.

agni.notes: Episode 19: Agni, god of fire. am_puck lowered 2.5 st (Uttanka uses it at +0.5): bright but deep, a crackle of warmth.

garuda.notes: Episode 19+: Garuda. am_liam lowered 1.5 st (Shringin uses it at +0.5): young, strong, earnest.

nagas.notes: Episode 20+: the serpents as a group: a cool whisper, lowered 2 st.

enchantress.notes: Reserved (the enchantress does not speak in the CE's account).

brahmin.notes: Episode 22: the brahmin in Garuda's throat. am_eric raised 1.5 st (Parikshit uses it at −1): calm, unafraid, a householder's voice.

valakhilyas.notes: Episodes 24–25: the thumb-sized sages as a group: the elder sage's deep British voice raised 3.5 st and quicker: small, dry, unhurried (bm_lewis is Shaunaka unshifted and Brahma at −2).

brihaspati.notes: Episode 25: Brihaspati, teacher of the gods. bm_george lowered 1.5 st (Vyasa −2.5, Surya −1, Shamika 0): grave and exact.

shesha.notes: Episode 31+: Shesha (Ananta), the eldest serpent. am_echo lowered 3 st (Ganesha 0, Aruna +2.5): calm, deep, kind; never Takshaka's cold am_fenrir.

vasuki.notes: Episode 32+: Vasuki, king of the serpents. am_onyx lowered 1.5 st: heavy, worried, kingly (the asuras' am_onyx is −2.5 and slower).

elapatra.notes: Episode 32: Elapatra, the young serpent who remembers Brahma's words. af_river lowered 1 st: light, clear, apart from the serpents' chorus (af_nicole −2).

jaratkaru.notes: Episode 32+: Jaratkaru the ascetic. bm_george raised 1.5 st (Vyasa −2.5, Brihaspati −1.5, Surya −1, Shamika 0): lean, dry, exact.

nagini.notes: Episode 34+: Jaratkaru, Vasuki's sister, the sage's bride, Astika's mother. af_kore lowered 0.5 st: warm and steady; apart from Kadru (bf_alice) and Vinata (bf_lily).

astika.notes: Episode 38+: Astika, the boy. af_sky lowered 1.5 st: a boy's clear voice, unhurried (the pup uses it +3).

bhrigu.notes: Episodes 42–43: Bhrigu. am_fenrir lowered 1.5 st: a deep, hard old voice (Takshaka uses it −3, Vishnu −1; neither speaks in these episodes). The Bhrigus speak American, as the narrator does.

puloma.notes: Episode 42: Puloma, Bhrigu's wife. af_sarah (a new voice id): clear and tired.

puloman.notes: Episode 41: the rakshasa Puloman. am_onyx lowered 3.5 st, slow.

ruru.notes: Episodes 45–46: Ruru, the young sage. am_liam raised 1 st (Garuda uses it −1.5).

devaduta.notes: Episode 45: the messenger of the gods. am_echo raised 2 st: light, even.

dharma.notes: Episode 45: Dharmaraja, lord of the dead. am_santa lowered 3 st: grave, unhurried.

sahasrapat.notes: Episode 46: the old snake who was the sage Sahasrapat (one voice for both shapes). bm_lewis raised 1 st: old and mild (Shaunaka uses it unshifted and does not speak in ep 46).

parashara.notes: Episode 50: the sage Parashara. bm_lewis lowered 1 st; British, as his son Vyasa (bm_george).

satyavati.notes: Episode 50: Satyavati, the ferry girl. bf_emma raised 0.5 st (King Paushya's queen used it unshifted in ep 6).

dushyanta.notes: Episodes 53–58: King Dushyanta (CE Duhshanta). am_adam raised 0.5 st: young and regal (Indra uses it −1.5 and does not speak in this arc).

shakuntala.notes: Episodes 53–57: Shakuntala. af_bella unshifted (the enchantress entry, which never spoke, shares the voice id): warm, clear, firm in the court speech.

kanva.notes: Episodes 55–56: the sage Kanva. bm_george raised 0.5 st: an old, kind voice (Vyasa −2.5, Jaratkaru +1.5).

skyvoice.notes: Episode 58: the bodiless voice from the sky (CE 1.69.28). am_santa lowered 1 st: broad and calm (the Ocean −2 and Dharmaraja −3 use the same id in other arcs).

shukra.notes: Episodes 59–62: Shukra (Kavya Ushanas), priest of the asuras, a Bhargava. am_fenrir lowered 2 st: hard and old, close to Bhrigu's (−1.5), his forefather.

kacha.notes: Episodes 59–61: Kacha, Brihaspati's son, the student. am_puck unshifted: young and bright (Uttanka +0.5, another student, in episode 6).

devayani.notes: Episodes 60–62: Devayani, Shukra's daughter. af_heart raised 1 st: young, proud, quick to feeling (Sarama uses it −1.5 in episode 5).
